style: Dense board-game diorama miniature, elevated three-quarter top-down view, hand-painted texture, crisp tiny details, warm saturated colors, soft drop shadow beneath, transparent background (PNG alpha). The object should be a self-contained sprite about 100x120 pixels conceptually, centered in frame with empty space around it.

images.prompt: A miniature diorama of a dark gravitational singularity artifact — a small obsidian monolith or obelisk that visibly warps the space around it. The stone surface is jet black with faint teal-cyan mathematical equations and grid lines glowing on its faces. The surrounding air/space is distorted — concentric ripple rings bending inward toward the object like a gravitational lens. Tiny golden light trails spiral around it like optimization paths being pulled toward a minimum. Small glowing teal beacon lights at the base. The overall feeling is a tiny black hole monument that bends reality around itself. Dark, mysterious, scientific, but rendered as a whimsical board-game piece.
